summary: Proposed chat schema v1 in one WAL SQLite file on btrfs, 8 writer processes x 1000 messages plus 2 polling readers. synchronous=NORMAL: 8000 of 8000 stored, 0 errors, write p99 2.387 ms, max 429.033 ms; reader p99 0.727 ms. synchronous=FULL: 3 of 8000 transactions failed after waiting out the 5000 ms busy timeout (caught as sqlite3.Error; the message was not recorded) (max 5004.351 ms; the same 3 failures appeared in an earlier run with a draft schema), readers unaffected. Database, WAL and shm files were 0600 under umask 077. A connection authorizer refused writes to grants. A fresh python -I process opening the file and running the grant check plus mention digest took 9.44 ms median against 6.96 ms for a bare start.

method.probe: stdlib-only script kept outside the repository, run with python3 -I against a new 0700 directory on the btrfs filesystem that holds the home directory, removed afterwards
method.schema: schema_sql below, which is the DDL proposed in docs/work/agent-chat.md, executed verbatim
method.write_transaction: BEGIN IMMEDIATE; INSERT message (about 230 bytes); INSERT mention; COMMIT
method.reader_poll: BEGIN; unread-mention digest query (LIMIT 5); SELECT count(*) FROM messages; COMMIT; sleep 10 ms
method.start: all processes connect first, then start together on one event
method.hook_cold_path: 25 fresh python3 -I processes each: import sqlite3, connect with a 200 ms timeout, PRAGMA query_only, grant lookup, digest query
method.not_measured: ancestry walk cost, the real tongs-agents-hook import set, macOS and Windows, network filesystems

schema_sql: kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('maintainer', 'agent')),
launch_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES participants(id),
handle TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(handle) BETWEEN 1 AND 32 AND handle <> 'maintainer'),
level TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (level IN ('chat', 'chat+wake')),
granted_via TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (granted_via IN ('sidebar', 'cli'))
name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 32),
created_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES participants(id),
archived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (archived IN (0, 1))
channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES channels(id),
author TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES participants(id),
body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(CAST(body AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 8192),
CREATE INDEX messages_by_channel ON messages(channel_id, id);
CREATE INDEX messages_by_thread ON messages(thread_id, id) WHERE thread_id IS NOT NULL;
target TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES participants(id),
message_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES messages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
participant TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES participants(id),
channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES channels(id),
participant TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES participants(id),
